roadmap.title: Story Playthrough & Chapter 1 Missable Watch
roadmap.summary: Play through Chapters 1 to 5 at your own pace without activating cheat codes (cheats disable trophies). Right after the Chapter 1 mission 'Down to Earth', accept Lucia's morning balcony meditation at Jason's house — it is the sole unconfirmed missable window in the entire list.
roadmap.tip: Never activate cheats on your Platinum save, and keep a manual backup save in Chapter 1 right after 'Down to Earth'.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks Character Strands
roadmap.summary: Clear all 8 Strangers & Freaks arcs across Leonida in post-story free roam — wrapping the five named character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) alongside Bret's unique-animal hunting request. None of these strands lock out after credits.
roadmap.tip: Sleep or advance in-game time between stranger encounters when waiting for follow-up phone texts.

roadmap.title: Collectibles, Map Discovery & Meditations
roadmap.summary: Sweep Leonida district by district to clear all 52 map zones, scan 100 WAiNK curiosities, complete 3 full Collectible Card decks, sample 100 unique vehicles, and finish the remaining 17 meditation sessions across the state's 10 meditation spots.
roadmap.tip: Grab a helicopter after credits to defog outer islands and rooftops while chaining WAiNK scans.

roadmap.title: Activities, Ranges & Races
roadmap.summary: Tackle Leonida's skill block: earn Gold on all 42 Shooting Range challenges, land 250 stunts, win Top Fun drone races at all 14 venues, win 20 unique races, clear 50 Challenges, sample all 9 activity types, finish an arcade cabinet, and out-fish Cal.
roadmap.tip: Work through Shooting Range weapons after maxing character handling and focus stats for easier Gold scores.

roadmap.title: Heists, Secrets & Economy
roadmap.summary: Knock out bank vault escapes, stealth jewelry heists, armored trucks, all 9 gang illegal operations, hidden Easter eggs (VCIA jet takeoff, Rhino tank, UFO, showroom smash, bowling, drive-by), and the marked-bill laundering, shop spend, garage, and Scooter Bros economy goals.
roadmap.tip: Use endgame gear, silencers, and Key Cloner upgrades to breeze through vaults, gang stashes, and secret feats.

roadmap.title: 100% Completion & The Platinum
roadmap.summary: Tie off every remaining bar on the in-game Progress > Total Completion checklist to unlock 'A Long Road'. The instant 100% pops alongside your other 53 trophies, 'Vice Got a Price!' unlocks automatically.
roadmap.tip: Audit the pause menu's Total Completion ledger regularly so side tasks and collectibles stack together.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableNote: Unlocks automatically as soon as all 54 other base-game PS5 trophies are earned. Only Positive Mental Attitude carries an early Chapter 1 missable watch.
trophies.when: Triggers immediately when the 54th base-game trophy unlocks.
trophies.guide:
Unlock every other trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI's PlayStation 5 base list—2 Gold, 6 Silver, and 46 Bronze—to claim the Platinum automatically. Every requirement is strictly single-player with zero multiplayer or online components, so the entire hunt can be completed on a single clean offline save across the campaign and post-story free roam.

Two pitfalls can derail a Platinum run: activating any cheat code disables trophies on that save session, and skipping Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation after 'Down to Earth' risks locking out 'Positive Mental Attitude' since GTA VI has no mission replay. Keep a permanent manual backup save in Chapter 1, never enter cheats, and track 100% progress via Pause > Progress > Total Completion.
steps: Start a clean single-player save and keep cheat codes completely disabled throughout the playthrough
Finish all 12 story campaign trophies across Chapters 1 through 5
Lock in the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house right after 'Down to Earth' and keep a manual backup save
Clear all 8 Strangers & Freaks strands, all collectible sweeps, activities, shooting ranges, races, and stunts
Complete the free-roam heist, economy, and secret trophies before finishing the final bars of 'A Long Road' (100% Completion)
Let the 54th trophy register so 'Vice Got a Price!' unlocks immediately

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableNote: Automatic early campaign milestone in Chapter 1; cannot be bypassed on a standard playthrough.
trophies.when: Unlocks automatically upon finishing the opening Chapter 1 mission 'Gone Fishing'.
trophies.guide:
Complete the opening Chapter 1 campaign mission 'Gone Fishing' in the Leonida Keys. Follow the yellow main-story markers during the introductory hours to learn core movement, partner handoffs, and early coastal boat handling; the Bronze trophy pops as soon as the mission-passed banner appears.

No gold medal, accuracy threshold, or optional mission objective is required, so play naturally without stressing over retries. The only thing that can block this unlock is turning on cheat codes before finishing the job—keep cheats off and avoid skipping mission checkpoints if prompted after a fail.
steps: Launch a new campaign without activating any cheat codes
Follow the Chapter 1 story markers in the Leonida Keys until 'Gone Fishing' starts
Complete every primary objective through the coastal sequence
Wait for the mission-passed screen to confirm the Bronze unlock

citations.label: GTABase — GTA 6 Story Trophies & Mission Guide

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableNote: Automatic at the end of Chapter 1; remember to grab the Chapter 1 balcony meditation after 'Down to Earth' before leaving the chapter.
trophies.when: Unlocks automatically upon clearing the final mission of Chapter 1.
trophies.guide:
Finish every mandatory main-story mission in Chapter 1 to close out the opening Leonida Keys arc and transition into Chapter 2. Follow the golden campaign icons on your map at your own pace; story decisions and mission ratings do not affect this automatic progression trophy.

Before launching the Chapter 1 finale, double-check that you accepted Lucia's morning balcony meditation at Jason's house right after 'Down to Earth'. Because GTA VI lacks mission replay, leaving Chapter 1 without that opening 1/18 meditation is the sole unconfirmed missable risk on the road to Platinum—make a dedicated manual save slot beforehand.
steps: Play through the Chapter 1 story missions in the Leonida Keys without cheats
Immediately after 'Down to Earth', create a manual backup save and accept Lucia's balcony meditation
Complete the remaining mandatory Chapter 1 jobs
Clear the Chapter 1 finale so the transition to Chapter 2 pops the trophy

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableNote: Automatic story milestone awarded at the conclusion of Chapter 2.
trophies.when: Unlocks automatically upon finishing the final mission of Chapter 2.
trophies.guide:
Advance Jason and Lucia's campaign through all mandatory Chapter 2 missions until the narrative shifts into Chapter 3. Chapter 2 widens your access to Leonida's venues—including the story visit to Kolt & Associates' bowling alley during 'Hit Kingpin Bowling'—while keeping every side activity open afterward.

If you get hung up on a multi-stage shootout, restock body armor and snacks between story icons rather than rushing in under-geared. Don't worry about optional banter or missing the bowling trophy during 'Hit Kingpin Bowling'; the venue respawns on cooldown in free roam, and this chapter trophy unlocks automatically upon completion.
steps: Restock body armor, health items, and primary ammo between Chapter 2 story markers
Follow all mandatory Chapter 2 mission icons across Leonida
Watch for the bowling alley moment in 'Hit Kingpin Bowling' (also revisit-safe later)
Finish the Chapter 2 climax to trigger the trophy automatically

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableNote: Automatic story milestone awarded when Chapter 3 concludes.
trophies.when: Unlocks automatically upon clearing the final mission of Chapter 3.
trophies.guide:
Complete every required main-story mission across Vice City during Chapter 3 to advance into Chapter 4. Along the way you unlock essential mid-game heist gear—most notably the Key Cloner—which opens up post-story showroom and vault scores like 'Capital Offense'.

Heavy urban police responses begin escalating in Chapter 3, so keep a fast getaway vehicle topped up and use alleys or garages to break line of sight during mission escapes. Make sure autosave stays enabled and avoid any cheat input so the Chapter 3 completion flag registers cleanly.
steps: Follow the golden campaign markers throughout Vice City in Chapter 3
Keep a reliable rifle, shotgun, and spare armor equipped for urban gunfights
Unlock key Chapter 3 tools (including the Key Cloner) as the plot progresses
Complete the Chapter 3 finale to pop 'Vice City, Baby!'

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableNote: Automatic story milestone awarded upon wrapping up Chapter 4.
trophies.when: Unlocks automatically upon completing the final mission of Chapter 4.
trophies.guide:
Push through the late-game escalations of Chapter 4 by completing every mandatory story mission across Vice City and the outlying counties. Expect larger multi-wave set-pieces, tighter vehicle pursuits, and heavier enemy armor than earlier chapters.

What usually trips players up here is starting a major mission with half-empty magazines or no spare armor—always swing by Ammu-Nation before stepping into a main icon, and lean on Combat Focus during dense flanks to avoid checkpoint loops. The trophy unlocks automatically when Chapter 4 hands off to Chapter 5.
steps: Refill body armor, medical supplies, and upgraded rifle ammo before launching Chapter 4 icons
Complete all required Chapter 4 missions across Vice City and surrounding regions
Use hard cover and Combat Focus during multi-wave set-piece firefights
Trigger the transition into Chapter 5 to earn the Bronze trophy

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableNote: Automatic Gold trophy upon finishing the campaign finale; full free roam continues afterward for all cleanup.
trophies.when: Unlocks automatically upon completing the final main story mission.
trophies.guide:
Play through Chapter 5 and complete the final main-story mission to earn this Gold campaign trophy. Every narrative branch and tactical choice counts toward 'You Gotta Know When to Get Off', and finishing the credits drops you straight into unrestricted post-story free roam with full access to every remaining trophy.

Treat the finale like a full heist: buy maximum armor, upgrade your primary rifle and sniper with extended magazines, and top off explosives before triggering the point of no return. Keep a manual pre-finale save just in case a game crash interrupts the end credits before the Gold trophy registers.
steps: Create a clean manual save before launching the final Chapter 5 mission
Stock full armor, healing items, explosives, and maxed rifle/shotgun ammo
Complete all remaining Chapter 5 story missions leading into the finale
Finish the final mission and let the credits conclude to unlock the Gold trophy and post-story free roam

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: Mandatory story mission; unlocks automatically during normal campaign play.
trophies.when: Unlocks automatically when the main story mission 'Breakfast Run' ends.
trophies.guide:
Advance along the main campaign path until the story mission 'Breakfast Run' appears on your map, then complete every objective through to the mission-passed banner. Because this is a mandatory plot job for Jason and Lucia, you cannot bypass it on a normal playthrough.

No special stealth rating or optional checklist is required—focus on keeping your partner covered during transitions and staying inside the mission vehicle path so you don't trigger an out-of-bounds fail. Once the closing escape clears, 'Trust' pops automatically.
steps: Progress the main storyline until 'Breakfast Run' unlocks on the map
Check your weapon wheel and armor before entering the mission trigger
Complete all scripted sequences, combat beats, and getaway objectives
Confirm 'Trust' unlocks on the mission-passed screen

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableNote: Required story heist; unlocks regardless of setup approach or take split.
trophies.when: Unlocks automatically after finishing the story mission 'The Cartel Heist'.
trophies.guide:
Finish all preparatory setup missions leading into 'The Cartel Heist', then execute the main heist itself and escape the pursuit. Every tactical approach and crew/take configuration unlocks 'Break the Bank' identically upon mission completion.

Cartel enforcers hit hard in tight interiors, so carry a high-capacity rifle plus a shotgun for close breaches and don't get greedy lingering in open doorways while looting. Keep your getaway vehicle intact on the exit run—wrecking it under heavy fire is the easiest way to lose time on a checkpoint reset.
steps: Complete every mandatory setup job required to unlock 'The Cartel Heist'
Stock full body armor, medical items, and both midrange and close-quarters firearms
Execute your chosen vault approach and clear cartel defenders from cover
Secure the take and escape pursuit to trigger 'Break the Bank'

citations.label: PSNProfiles — Official Hidden Story Heist Trophy

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableNote: Required story mission; awarded automatically on completion.
trophies.when: Unlocks automatically upon completing the main mission 'Child's Play'.
trophies.guide:
Follow the primary campaign track until the story mission 'Child's Play' becomes active, then finish all of its objectives to unlock 'Family Matters'. This is a mandatory narrative milestone with no hidden rank, timer, or bonus condition attached.

Keep an eye on mission prompts when switching roles or escorting objectives so you don't accidentally abandon a key character or vehicle. As soon as the final scripted beat wraps and the mission-passed banner appears, the Bronze trophy pops automatically.
steps: Continue the main story mission chain until 'Child's Play' appears
Trigger the mission with full health and standard combat gear ready
Follow all primary objectives and character handoffs without straying out of bounds
Clear the closing sequence to unlock 'Family Matters'

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableNote: Required campaign mission; automatically awarded on completion.
trophies.when: Unlocks automatically upon finishing the story mission 'Headliners'.
trophies.guide:
Progress the main storyline until 'Headliners' opens on your map and play it straight through to completion. This mission features crowded combat arenas where flanking enemies can melt your armor quickly if you fight in the open.

Use hard cover, save Combat Focus for high-density pushes, and watch the minimap for rear spawns so you clear the set-piece cleanly on one pass. No gold medal or optional constraint is required—finishing the final objective awards 'DWNFALL' immediately.
steps: Reach 'Headliners' along the main campaign progression path
Equip full armor and a steady midrange rifle before starting the mission
Clear crowded firefights using cover and Combat Focus bursts
Finish the final objective to pop 'DWNFALL'

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableNote: Required story set-piece at Vice City International Airport; cannot be missed.
trophies.when: Unlocks automatically upon completing 'VCIA Takedown'.
trophies.guide:
Play through the campaign until the Vice City International Airport set-piece 'VCIA Takedown' unlocks, then complete the infiltration, runway/tarmac combat, and extraction. Because airport tarmacs offer long sightlines with sparse cover, bring a scoped rifle alongside a fast-reloading automatic.

Don't sprint across open aprons while security vehicles and choppers are converging—advance behind luggage carts, hangars, and fuel trucks while picking off gunners first. Finishing the VCIA extraction unlocks 'Hi-Jacked' automatically with no rank requirement.
steps: Advance the main story until 'VCIA Takedown' activates
Bring full armor, a high-capacity rifle, and a long-range option for tarmac sightlines
Push through the airport infiltration using hangars and vehicles for cover
Complete the extraction sequence to unlock 'Hi-Jacked'

citations.label: Exophase — GTA VI PS5 Trophy Details

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: Mandatory late-game story operation; unlocks automatically on completion.
trophies.when: Unlocks automatically after finishing 'Operation Savage Glory'.
trophies.guide:
Continue through the late campaign chapters until 'Operation Savage Glory' unlocks, then finish the entire assault and getaway sequence. Expect armored opposition and vehicle reinforcements during the climax, making explosives and high-penetration rifles far more effective than sidearms.

Prioritize neutralizing heavy threats and keeping your partner's health intact during defensive holds so you avoid mid-battle fails. Once you shake pursuit and reach the mission-complete screen, 'Snow Storm' triggers automatically.
steps: Stock full armor, explosives, and maxed rifle/sniper ammo before starting 'Operation Savage Glory'
Clear the opening assault waves from solid cover while watching flank angles
Eliminate armored reinforcements and protect your partner during holdouts
Finish the getaway sequence to pop 'Snow Storm'

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableNote: Every component counted toward the 100% ledger can be completed after the main story. Note that 15 of 18 meditations count toward 100%, so even if the Chapter 1 balcony meditation were skipped, 100% itself remains reachable.
trophies.when: Usually your final trophy before the Platinum in Stage 6.
trophies.guide:
Fill every required category in Pause > Progress > Total Completion to reach 100% and unlock this Gold trophy. Per PowerPyx's 100% breakdown, Total Completion combines the full main story, Strangers & Freaks strands, major world collectibles (including 100 WAiNK scans, Collectible Card sets, and 15 of the 18 meditations), activities, races, shooting ranges, stunts, robberies, and miscellaneous world interactions.

Treat the in-game Total Completion ledger as your master audit screen during Stage 6—if you stall at 98–99%, inspect which individual sub-bar is short rather than guessing. Note that because only 15 of 18 meditations count toward 100%, 'A Long Road' itself stays fully reachable in post-story free roam even if the Chapter 1 balcony meditation were missed.
steps: Open Pause > Progress > Total Completion and note every sub-category percentage
Complete all main story chapters and the required Strangers & Freaks strands
Finish the required collectible totals (100 WAiNK scans, card decks, and at least 15 meditations)
Clear the required activities, races, shooting ranges, stunts, and robbery milestones
Audit any bar still under 100% and knock out remaining miscellaneous tasks until the Gold trophy unlocks

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableNote: All stunt jumps, fly-unders, and aerial stunt markers stay open permanently in free roam.
trophies.when: Best knocked out systematically during Stage 4 with a fast motorbike and nimble helicopter.
trophies.guide:
Complete 250 unique Stunts across Leonida (tracked live 0/250 on PS5). The stunt pool spans vehicle stunt jumps, under-the-bridge passes, knife flights, and district trick spots scattered from the Leonida Keys through downtown Vice City and the northern counties.

Two things waste the most time on stunts: using an overly heavy car that nose-dives off ramps, and retrying jumps after wrecking without a quick-save. Tune a nimble sportbike for ground ramps so you can level out mid-air and stick clean four-point/two-wheel landings, use a compact helicopter for bridge passes, and quick-save right before any water-gap or rooftop ramp.
steps: Fully upgrade a lightweight, responsive sportbike for ramp stunts and keep a nimble helicopter handy for bridge passes
Work systematically county by county so you don't lose track of uncompleted ramps
Drop a quick-save right before tight water-gap, alley, or rooftop stunt jumps
Approach ramps straight at the target speed—over-shooting often fails the landing zone
Verify each stunt registers on the HUD and in-game Progress tracker until 250/250 unlocks

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missableNote: All 9 activity categories remain playable indefinitely after the main campaign.
trophies.when: Track under Progress > Activities during Stage 4 cleanup.
trophies.guide:
Complete at least one full session of each of the 9 activity categories listed under Pause > Progress > Activities (tracked 0/9 on PS5). Per PowerPyx, you only need to finish one round of each category—covering shooting ranges, Top Fun drone races, standard races, fishing, arcade cabinets, gym workouts, bowling, and local pastimes—rather than winning every single variant.

Quitting mid-session or backing out before the results screen prevents an activity from registering on the 0/9 tracker. Always play through to the final scorecard, and stack this naturally while working on 'The Shootist', 'Top Fun', 'Baited My Tackle', 'Stick Fiddler', 'Personal Best', and 'Let's Go Bowling'.
steps: Open Pause > Progress > Activities to see which of the 9 activity types remain unchecked
Knock out trophy-overlapping activities first (shooting range, drone race, standard race, fishing, arcade, gym, bowling)
Finish any remaining unchecked local pastimes on the map through to their final results screen
Never quit an activity early—confirm the checkmark appears until 9/9 pops 'Master of None'

citations.label: PowerPyx — Master of None (9 Activity Types List)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missableNote: Every shooting range venue and challenge remains replayable anytime in free roam.
trophies.when: Best tackled in Stage 4 once your shooting skill and extended weapon magazines are upgraded.
trophies.guide:
Earn a Gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across Leonida's licensed ranges and Ammu-Nation venues (tracked 0/42 on PS5). Each weapon class has tiered targets where Gold requires sustained accuracy multipliers and fast target transitions rather than spray-and-pray fire.

Do not grind this early in Chapter 1 with base stats and tiny magazines—wait until Stage 4 when your shooting handling is maxed and you own extended magazines and low-recoil barrels/grips for every weapon tier. Missing a stray shot breaks your score multiplier, so prioritize steady bullseye/headshot rhythms and reload only during brief target-flip pauses.
steps: Wait until late game/Stage 4 when character shooting handling is maxed
Buy extended magazines and recoil-reducing attachments for every range weapon class
Focus on unbroken bullseye/headshot streaks to keep the score multiplier maxed
Check the Progress menu to track remaining Gold medals at every range venue
Clear all 42/42 Gold thresholds to unlock 'The Shootist'

citations.label: PowerPyx — Shooting Range Gold Tips & Guide

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missableNote: All 14 Top Fun drone race spots can be replayed as many times as needed in free roam.
trophies.when: Sweep all 14 drone course markers during Stage 4.
trophies.guide:
Win a Top Fun Drone Race (1st place finish) at every one of Leonida's 14 drone race locations (tracked 0/14 on PS5). Courses weave through urban alleys, piers, parking structures, and coastal overlooks, and every completed win also contributes toward 'Master of None' and 100% completion.

Holding full boost nonstop is the #1 reason players clip gate frames and spin out into 3rd place. Treat your first run at an unfamiliar venue as a sight-reading lap, feather throttle before sharp 90-degree gates, bank early into the next ring, and hit instant restart the moment a crash drops you behind the pack.
steps: Reveal all 14 Top Fun Drone Race icons across Leonida (easiest after defogging the map)
Run a quick scouting lap on tight urban courses to memorize sharp elevation drops
Feather throttle through narrow checkpoint rings and reserve boost for clean straightaways
Finish 1st at every distinct venue—2nd place does not advance the 0/14 tracker
Verify all 14/14 locations register on the PSN counter

citations.label: GTABase — Top Fun Drone Race Locations

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableNote: All street, off-road, water, and air races remain open after finishing the campaign.
trophies.when: Combine with Top Fun and 100% activity sweeps in Stage 4.
trophies.guide:
Finish 1st across 20 unique race events in Leonida (tracked 0/20 on PS5). The roster includes street circuits, off-road/swamp tracks, sea races, and air courses; replaying a race you already won will not add to the counter.

Show up with fully upgraded custom rides from your garages (street supercar, sportbike, off-roader) so you can pull away cleanly on straightaways and recover from traffic bumps. Watch the map legend for the gold winner checkmark after each race so you never waste time repeating a completed circuit.
steps: Upgrade a top street car, motorbike, and off-road vehicle at a mod shop before starting
Filter the map for uncompleted race events across Vice City, Keys, swamps, and water/air courses
Brake smoothly into hairpins rather than wall-riding to stay ahead of rubber-banding AI
Confirm the gold winner checkmark appears on each unique event (no repeats count)
Win 20/20 distinct races to unlock 'Earn Cash, Not Kudos'

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableNote: Unlocks after Chapter 1's 'Feng Shui' once Cal texts you; can be attempted or replayed in post-story free roam.
trophies.when: Available from Chapter 1 after 'Feng Shui' (once Cal sends his text) all the way through post-story free roam.
trophies.guide:
After finishing the Chapter 1 story mission 'Feng Shui', wait for Cal to send a text message inviting you out fishing (per PowerPyx and GTABase), then travel to his map marker and beat his total score in a head-to-head fishing challenge. The challenge remains available and replayable all the way into post-story free roam.

Snapping your line by mashing reel while a heavy fish is thrashing is the fastest way to lose to Cal. Watch the rod bend and line-tension indicator: pause reeling and steer against the fish's run whenever tension spikes red, then reel steadily the instant it tires so you bank high-weight catches cleanly.
steps: Complete Chapter 1's 'Feng Shui' and wait for Cal's phone text invitation
Drive to Cal's fishing icon on the map and initiate the fishing challenge
Cast toward deeper ripple pockets for larger, higher-scoring fish
Stop reeling whenever line tension spikes red, then pull steadily while the fish rests
Out-score Cal before the challenge ends to unlock 'Baited My Tackle'

citations.label: PowerPyx — Baited My Tackle Fishing Walkthrough

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missableNote: Arcade cabinets in bars, boardwalks, and hangouts stay playable forever.
trophies.when: Anytime you find a playable arcade cabinet in Vice City or the Keys (Stage 4).
trophies.guide:
Find any playable retro arcade cabinet inside Vice City bars, boardwalk arcades, piers, or hangouts and beat it all the way through its final stage and ending screen. Simply launching a cabinet or setting a high score without finishing the final stage will not pop 'Stick Fiddler'.

Sample a couple of cabinets to pick the shortest, most predictable game whose enemy patterns click for you, and keep extra pocket cash on hand in case the cabinet permits continues. Backing out early or letting the continue countdown expire resets your run, so finish the final boss/level in one sitting.
steps: Visit a boardwalk arcade, bar, or hangout in Vice City or the Keys with playable cabinets
Test available cabinets and pick the shortest game with clean, learnable patterns
Keep extra cash on hand to use continues if the cabinet allows them
Clear every stage and defeat the final boss/goal to reach the ending screen and unlock the trophy

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: Andy's Strangers & Freaks strand remains fully accessible after the main story.
trophies.when: Complete Andy's full Strangers & Freaks chain during Stage 2.
trophies.guide:
Locate Andy's '?' Strangers & Freaks icon in Leonida and complete every installment in his character chain through to his final mission. Andy's entire strand remains open in post-story free roam and directly ticks off one of the 8 strands required for 'Strangers & Freaks'.

If Andy's next marker does not pop up right after finishing a part, don't assume it's bugged—multi-part stranger chains often require in-game time to pass or a protagonist swap before the next phone text arrives. Sleep at a safehouse once or twice, check both Jason and Lucia's messages, and finish Andy's closing job.
steps: Find Andy's opening '?' Strangers & Freaks marker on the map
Complete each mission in Andy's chain as it unlocks
Sleep at a safehouse or swap protagonists if a follow-up text/marker pauses
Finish Andy's final mission to pop 'Road to Rehabilitation'

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Kenton's Strangers & Freaks strand never locks out and can be finished post-story.
trophies.when: Finish Kenton's Strangers & Freaks strand during Stage 2.
trophies.guide:
Meet Kenton at his Strangers & Freaks '?' marker and play through every job in his multi-part strand until his finale concludes. Kenton's storyline never locks out after credits and counts toward both this hidden Bronze trophy and the 8-strand 'Strangers & Freaks' Silver.

Because Kenton's encounters lean coastal, stock armor and versatile mid-to-long-range weapons before triggering each stage so open-water or dock fights don't catch you short. If his next mission takes a moment to spawn, pass 6–12 in-game hours at a safehouse and check your phone inbox.
steps: Locate and trigger Kenton's opening Strangers & Freaks encounter
Bring body armor and reliable midrange weaponry for coastal objectives
Clear all intermediate missions, sleeping at a safehouse between parts if needed
Complete Kenton's final mission to unlock 'This Was No Boat Accident'

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: Billy's entire Strangers & Freaks questline stays available in post-story free roam.
trophies.when: Complete Billy's Strangers & Freaks arc during Stage 2.
trophies.guide:
Track down Billy's Strangers & Freaks '?' marker in Leonida and complete his full sequence of side missions through to the finale. Like the other four named stranger arcs, Billy's chain stays fully accessible after the main campaign and counts toward 'Strangers & Freaks'.

Some stranger follow-ups only show up on the radar for the specific protagonist who handles that arc or after a brief narrative cooldown. Check both Jason and Lucia on the map and advance time at a safehouse if Billy's next icon isn't immediately visible, then wrap his concluding job for 'The Lone Rider'.
steps: Start Billy's Strangers & Freaks strand from his initial map icon
Complete every intermediate job in Billy's progression chain
Swap between Jason and Lucia or sleep at a safehouse if the next icon is delayed
Finish Billy's final mission to unlock 'The Lone Rider'

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: All 8 required Strangers & Freaks strands remain available after the campaign ends.
trophies.when: Completes at the end of Stage 2 once all 8 stranger chains are wrapped.
trophies.guide:
Complete 8 full Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida (tracked 0/8 on PS5). Five strands have dedicated finale trophies—Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, and Tyrone—leaving three additional complete strands (such as Bret's hunting encounters and other regional '?' characters) to reach 8/8.

The biggest reason players think they are stuck at 6/8 or 7/8 is forgetting that several '?' markers are protagonist-specific or only appear after advancing in-game time. Alternate between Jason and Lucia while scanning the full map, read unread phone texts, and finish every strand all the way to its final mission—partial strands don't count.
steps: Switch between both Jason and Lucia to uncover all protagonist-specific '?' icons
Complete all 5 named finale strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, and Tyrone
Clear 3 additional complete stranger strands across Leonida (including Bret's line)
Sleep at safehouses and read phone texts to trigger delayed final parts
Confirm 8/8 finished strands on the PSN tracker to unlock the Silver trophy

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: The late-night UFO encounter repeats reliably whenever you meet the time and solo conditions.
trophies.when: Visit Kelly County solo after 2:00 AM during Stage 5.
trophies.guide:
Trigger Leonida's hidden late-night UFO encounter in Kelly County. Per PowerPyx's walkthrough, travel to the backcountry clearing northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2:00 AM in-game time, wait in the clearing, and watch the night sky until the UFO event activates overhead.

Two strict conditions break this spawn if ignored: arriving with your partner tagging along, or showing up before 2:00 AM. Make sure you have no active Wanted Level and drive to Kelly County
Head into the backcountry northwest of the Starlet Motel
Pass time nearby until after 2:00 AM in-game clock time
Wait in the clearing and watch the night sky for the UFO encounter to pop the trophy

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missableNote: Can be performed anywhere in free roam on a motorbike.
trophies.when: Quick 30-second motorcycle stunt during Stage 5.
trophies.guide:
Ride any motorcycle, switch to a one-handed melee weapon (such as a baseball bat, crowbar, or machete) on your weapon wheel while mounted, and perform a vehicular melee drive-by swing to knock a target flat on the pavement. This takes under a minute anywhere in Stage 5 free roam.

Running the target over with your front tire or clipping them with the bike frame counts as a vehicle hit rather than a melee drive-by, which won't pop 'Ten Pin'. Ride parallel along a wide boardwalk or quiet street at moderate speed, keep a clean half-meter gap beside the target, and time the side melee swing so the weapon itself bowls them over.
steps: Grab a nimble motorcycle and cycle your weapon wheel to a one-handed melee weapon (bat/crowbar/machete)
Find an open boardwalk or wide sidewalk with targets in a clear line
Ride parallel at moderate speed—avoid hitting the target with your bike wheels directly
Execute the melee drive-by strike cleanly beside the target to bowl them over and unlock 'Ten Pin'

Deliver dirty stacks promptly to your criminal laundering contacts rather than carrying them into risky fights
Collect the converted clean cash payouts as each laundering drop clears

Upgrade your race and stunt vehicles at mod shops and pick up luxury apparel/watches at Vice City boutiques

Store or purchase 10 distinct eligible vehicles across your owned garages, open the Scooter Bros app, and confirm each slot shows as registered until 10/10 unlocks 'On the Spot'.

Open the Scooter Bros app on your in-game smartphone
Register each of the 10 distinct vehicles to your Scooter Bros roster until 10/10 pops the trophy
